name: Mukbang Students
desc:
🍟 SNEAK SNACKS. DON'T GET CAUGHT. 🍟

One player is the TEACHER. Everyone else hides in a class full of NPC students... and the teacher has no idea which ones are real.

📚 STUDENTS
Snack, text and pass notes the second the teacher turns to write on the board. Every bit of mischief fills the class bar. Fill it before the bell and the whole class wins!

✏️ TEACHER
Spot the real players hiding in the crowd. Throw chalk, grab the troublemakers and tie them to a pillar. Catch them all before the bell!

#worstclassever #classroom #school #teacher #students #hideandseek #prank #snacks #sneaky #dontgetcaught #party #funny #multiplayer #friends #escape #roleplay

llm.loop: students hide among NPCs and sneak snacks when the teacher looks away to fill the class bar; teacher hunts the real players before the bell
llm.objectives: students: fill mischief bar unseen; teacher: catch all real players
llm.progression: gems, gold, battle pass, ability rolls
llm.instructions: one teacher, rest are students hiding among NPCs; snack and pass notes when teacher turns
unique: social-deduction hide-in-the-crowd in a classroom with snack sneaking
llm.thumbnails: first-person hands sneaking burger from desk drawer; Baldi-like teacher behind students
llm.complexity_notes: single classroom map, NPC students, role logic
